# Augment Code

> > Enterprise AI-powered development platform featuring spec-driven development, MCP server integrations, and automated code workflows for modern software teams.

Augment Code provides developer tools and guides for AI-assisted software development, with extensive Model Context Protocol (MCP) server registry entries for integrating LLMs with databases, Kubernetes, data extraction, and development environments. The platform emphasizes context engineering, security automation, and enterprise-scale code understanding.

## Key Topics

- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Spec-driven development
- AI agents and automation
- Context engineering
- Enterprise development workflows
- Kubernetes integration
- LLM integration patterns
- Code review and security
- Developer productivity
- Python and Node.js servers
- Docker containerization
- OAuth and JWT authentication
- PostgreSQL and Trino databases
- Vulnerability detection
- Computer-using agents

## Developer Guides

- [Mastering AI Context — and why it matters more than token count](https://www.augmentcode.com/guides/mastering-ai-context-and-why-it-matters-more-than-token-count): Technical guide to AI context management for enterprise codebases
- [7 Ways Context Engineering Supercharges Enterprise AI Dev](https://www.augmentcode.com/guides/7-ways-context-engineering-supercharges-enterprise-ai-dev): Guide to context engineering for enterprise AI development
- [Spec-Driven Development & AI Agents Explained](https://www.augmentcode.com/guides/spec-driven-development-ai-agents-explained): Guide to spec-driven development with multi-agent coordination
- [12 Ways Computer-Using Agents Transform IT Workflows](https://www.augmentcode.com/guides/12-ways-computer-using-agents-transform-it-workflows): Guide to automating IT workflows with computer-using agents
- [Spec-Driven Frontend Migration With AI Prompts](https://www.augmentcode.com/guides/spec-driven-frontend-migration-with-ai-prompts): Guide to automating frontend migrations using spec-driven AI agents
- [How to Do Code Review: A Practical Guide for Developers](https://www.augmentcode.com/guides/how-to-do-code-review-a-practical-guide-for-developers): Evidence-based code review guide using Google's framework

## MCP Server Registry - Infrastructure & DevOps

- [k8m - Kubernetes Management](https://www.augmentcode.com/mcp/k8m): AI-driven Kubernetes dashboard with MCP integration and 49+ tools
- [mcp-k8s-go - Kubernetes Go Server](https://www.augmentcode.com/mcp/mcp-k8s-go): Golang MCP server exposing Kubernetes clusters via chat interface
- [mcp-trino - Distributed SQL Engine](https://www.augmentcode.com/mcp/mcp-trino): MCP server exposing Trino distributed SQL engine via STDIO/HTTP transports
- [isaac-sim-mcp - NVIDIA Isaac Sim](https://www.augmentcode.com/mcp/isaac-sim-mcp): MCP extension adding natural-language control to NVIDIA Isaac Sim

## MCP Server Registry - Data & Development Tools

- [OpenDataMCP - Open Data Framework](https://www.augmentcode.com/mcp/opendatamcp): MCP framework connecting open data to LLMs with CLI and provider tools
- [jupyter-mcp-server - Notebook Integration](https://www.augmentcode.com/mcp/jupyter-mcp-server): MCP server for real-time Jupyter notebook interaction and execution
- [agentql-mcp - Web Data Extraction](https://www.augmentcode.com/mcp/agentql-mcp): MCP server integrating AgentQL web data extraction tool
- [jadx-ai-mcp - Android Decompiler](https://www.augmentcode.com/mcp/jadx-ai-mcp): JADX decompiler MCP plugin for LLM-powered Android APK analysis
- [imagesorcery-mcp - Image Processing](https://www.augmentcode.com/mcp/imagesorcery-mcp): MCP server providing image processing tools via OpenCV and Ultralytics
- [mcp-summarizer - Content Summarization](https://www.augmentcode.com/mcp/mcp-summarizer): MCP server using Gemini 1.5 Pro for multi-format content summarization
